## Safety

Do not publish credentials, private keys, client QR/config payloads, subscription
URLs/tokens, recovery codes, serial numbers or sensitive network configuration.
Use reserved example addresses and redact logs before attaching them. Security
vulnerabilities follow SECURITY.md rather than a public issue.

## Description

Describe the problem, affected workflow, acceptance criteria and alternatives. Do not assume a planned capability already exists.
